t: Dual-sided, textured heavy-duty wipes with bio-based cleansers quickly and effectively removes stubborn industrial muck and grime. Easily removes paint, oil, PU foam, silicone, grease, gap fill, adhesive and sealant from hands, tools and surfaces. High adhesion scrub side grabs the grime, smooth side soaks up any leftover muck. Featuring closed-cell fabric technology to capture and contain dirt and grime without releasing it. Free of artificial preservatives, parabens, sulphates and formaldehyde. Dermatologically tested with Aloe Vera and Vitamin E to protect and nourish hands.
b: For Medium to Heavy Duty Work
